Fixed in 6c3e261. ~F no longer widens the f32 to f64 (1.0e-10 printed 0.0000000001000000013351432), keeps the trailing point including at ~,0F ('4.' not '4'), and ~E now uses a lowercase marker with a signed exponent (1.0e+10). Key finding: ~F uses TWO rounding regimes - pad with zeros when more fraction digits are requested than the shortest decimal carries (so ~,3F of 3.4028235e38 is ...350000...000, not the exact binary value), and round the EXACT value with ties away from zero when fewer are requested (~,2F of 1.005 is 1.00 since that f32 is 1.00499999523162841796875; ~,1F of 0.25 is 0.3 since that f32 is exact). Rust's {:.N} rounds half-to-even and gets 0.25 wrong, so rounding is done on the digit string. Verified against SBCL: 15 rounding edge cases x 5 directives + 9 magnitudes x 6 directives, all byte-identical. Also corrected two acceptance assertions that encoded the old wrong behaviour (SBCL confirms both).

Fixed in d5ee100. The builder now records block_id -> (resume_bcp, sp_restore) in the leader scan, makes resume_bcp a leader, propagates depth sp_restore+1 along the ReturnFrom edge, and emits a Jump terminator after truncating the operand stack to sp_restore and pushing the value. No hand-built phi: the operand stack is already Braun-numbered as Var::Stack(k), so matching what normal completion leaves lets the existing merge machinery handle it. A direct jump is sound because the builder declines everything needing real unwinding (PushUnwind unmodelled; PushBlock/PushTag accepted only at sp_restore == 0). ReturnFromNamed still declines.

Fixed in 67efc9b. Root cause was NOT the rooted-list machinery (four hypotheses there all disproven by instrumentation) but a heap-exhaustion corruption chain: CLOS instances were allocated in the nursery then pinned, each pinned nursery object forced its whole 1MB region to be retained forever (~316 instances poisoned 316 of 512 regions, census-verified), nothing could reclaim anything (old_occupancy_trigger was dead config, no automatic major GC, Survivor regions unreclaimable by ANY collector), and when 0 Free regions remained, minor evacuation SILENTLY DROPPED live objects - roots kept stale pointers, the nursery was zeroed under them, and the mutator read a corrupted macro-expansion form as 'unbound variable: CONS'.

Fixes: instances allocate directly into packed pinned-host regions (no nursery retention); pinned allocs pack into dedicated hosts that ordinary evacuation never targets; old_occupancy_trigger wired to run a major after a crossing minor; major treats Survivor like OldGen (evacuate <50% live, free zero-live); size-aware target-region finder (the fixed '>header+align' test could lose objects even with Free regions available); evacuation failure is now a loud panic with a region census, and the major frees only fully-evacuated regions ('let _ = copy_object' used to swallow failure then free the region, zeroing live objects).

VERIFIED: both reproducers pass under BLISS_DISABLE_T2=1 BLISS_GC_STRESS=1 - v5.lisp (cons: 300, previously the error point) with ZERO region retentions and zero majors needed, and the original keep-loopdiff.lisp with all 8 entries cold==hot ok. CLOS make-instance stress workload clean under GC_STRESS+POISON+VERIFY. Full suite green serially. ASDF loads; asdf instruction count unchanged (41.37G). gc-root-lint clean.

The BLISS_GC_VERIFY/BLISS_GC_CENSUS diagnostics that found this are kept (env-gated): verify failures now self-diagnose (mark/relocate visit trace, holder naming via trace-fn pointer, target header/index state), census names what pinned each retained region.

Follow-ups filed: bliss-334 sharpened (instances still immortal, now cheap), gensym immortality bead, LargeObject pinned-sweep gap bead.

Fixed by 67efc9b (bliss-wc4t) — retested 2026-09-04, all reproducers clean: (1) the deterministic packages.lisp + specials.lisp load under BLISS_GC_STRESS=1 BLISS_GC_POISON=1, previously 3/3 abort at line 83, now 3/3 OK; (2) the minimal noop-macro repro (defmacro noop + 400 calls under BLISS_GC_STRESS=3), previously reliable abort past ~100 calls, now clean.

CORRECTED CLASSIFICATION: this beads long history (mine included) chased an unrooted-Rust-local stale-pointer write. The real mechanism was wc4ts heap-region exhaustion: pre-fix, Survivor regions were never reclaimed by ANY collector and pinned-nursery CLOS instances retained whole 1MB regions, so cumulative allocation churn (macro expansions allocate forms that survive a GC or two and get copied to survivor space) exhausted the 512-region heap; minor evacuation then SILENTLY DROPPED live objects, and the next allocations failed/corrupted — the '16 bytes failed' signature. That is why it was cumulative, context-dependent, immune to form-level bisection, and invisible to VERIFY-as-it-was and to form-structure validation: every synthetic single-form probe was innocent; the heap was simply full.

This also retroactively explains bliss-255 (same signature) — worth a retest if it has a repro. Evacuation starvation now panics loudly with a region census instead of corrupting, so any recurrence will name itself.
